quotes: This week, the South Ukraine NPP detected 13 drones in its monitoring area, while the Chornobyl site detected 15 drones.
The Rivne and Khmelnytskyy NPPs each reported detecting three and two drones respectively.
The IAEA team at the Khmelnytskyy NPP also had to shelter on 9 September because of an air raid alert and were requested to go to shelter again on 10 September.
An IAEA field team observed the work, and the line was reconnected on the evening of 7 September, ending the ZNPP’s 26th loss of off-site power during the conflict.
